name: Bootcamp Connect
role: Team project, 2026. Design system, accessibility and AI-assisted development
problem: Bootcamp graduates need real experience to get hired, but most projects stop after demo day.
approach: An installable app where software and business developers join real opportunities, run them as projects with a team chat, and earn verified experience. Built spec-first with Claude Code, to Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and WCAG 2.2 AA.
result: Working alpha with Google sign-in, a ranked feed, AI-powered CV and LinkedIn import with a review step, browser tests and CI.

name: Windfall
role: Team prototype, 2026. Service and interaction design
problem: Good food goes to waste while many people eat alone.
approach: A clickable mobile prototype for small hosted suppers built around surplus food: discover a gathering, RSVP, host your own, with a trust and safety layer.
result: Built to click through with stakeholders for a Brighton and Hove pilot.

name: 3D product demo
problem: Static product images do not let people explore a product.
approach: An interactive 3D scene in the browser, built with Vue and Three.js.
result: A responsive 3D experience that runs in any modern browser.
